features.name: Layered embedded objects
features.notes: Must cover object hit testing, z-order, selection, movement, and resizing.

features.name: File attachments
features.limitation: Insert dialog and copy operation are under active verification.
features.notes: Keep image, video, audio, and generic-file behavior distinct.

features.name: Themes and visual states
features.limitation: Visual verification is still required for each supported theme.
features.notes: Check normal, hover, pressed, focused, disabled, and selected states.

features.name: RTL text and caret behavior
features.limitation: The product requirement remains broader than the current verification set.
features.notes: Include Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu, mixed direction, selection, paste, and undo.

features.name: Local logging and telemetry
features.limitation: Nothing is sent automatically; export is user initiated.
features.notes: Keep logging levels, session IDs, retention, export, and clear behavior documented.
